summary: SOLAI Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of an NYSE notice of noncompliance with continued listing standards due to average market capitalization below $50 million over 30 trading days and stockholders' equity below $50 million as of December 31, 2025. The company has 90 days to submit a business plan to regain compliance within 18 months; failure may lead to suspension and delisting. Accelerated delisting may occur if ADS trade below $0.10. The notice does not immediately affect trading. The filing is a foreign private issuer's report mapping to a U.S. equivalent of an 8-K item for delisting risk. Watch for the business plan submission and NYSE acceptance to gauge listing viability.
